targets.outcome_quote: In sum, using three times the sample size as the original study, we find no evidence that being exposed to an elevated vertical position increases risk taking, at least when risk is operationalized as the likelihood of purchasing new products.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall conclusion of no evidence for target effect. Blog links the original but gives no reference-list author/year or printed DOI; these fields remain empty.
